description: Extend docs/AWS_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md with a clearly-marked, append-only 'DPI 2 additions (PROPOSED)' section covering Cognito (+Google Workspace SSO/MFA + 4 RBAC roles), DynamoDB as the LIVE primary store replacing SQLite (and its effect of ECS autoscaling to >=2 tasks across AZs), the DynamoDB Streams->Lambda Notifier->SNS + Slack/Teams notifier pipeline, CloudWatch Synthetics + Route 53 health checks, CloudWatch Logs Insights + S3 export, the new secrets to inject (Slack/Teams webhook URLs, Cognito config), and the new least-privilege IAM task-role permissions (DynamoDB, SNS, CloudWatch Synthetics/Logs Insights, S3). Keep ALL existing DPI 1 content intact (add, do not rewrite), preserve the honesty framing (PROPOSED/TARGET, not deployed; Main/Payment subject to client access), and add a short pointer to docs/DPI2_PLAN_AND_GAP_ANALYSIS.md and the DPI 2 diagram output. This FEAT is independent of FEAT-001's code; it only references the DPI 2 diagram output filenames FEAT-001 produces.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/task-dpi2-diagram/context.json and this file FIRST, plus docs/DPI2_PLAN_AND_GAP_ANALYSIS.md (source of truth for the proposed services, the 4 RBAC roles, and the exact honesty framing) and the current docs/AWS_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md so the additions dovetail with the existing numbered sections. Follow plan section 5 in .agents/tasks/dpi2-diagram-plan.md.

Add a one-line pointer near the top of docs/AWS_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md (after the intro blockquote): a note that DPI 2 ('Radar UrbiNexus') proposed additions are in the new DPI 2 section and in docs/DPI2_PLAN_AND_GAP_ANALYSIS.md, and that the DPI 2 diagram is OUTPUT/Urbani_AWS_Architecture_Diagram_DPI2.svg (.png).

Append a NEW top-level section (## 11. DPI 2 additions (PROPOSED — "Radar UrbiNexus")) AFTER the existing ## 10. Pre-deploy checklist. Lead with an honesty banner: DPI 2 services are a PROPOSED target validated at kickoff; the delivered DPI 1 runtime is still SQLite + un-deployed CDK scaffolding; Main/Payment ingestion depends on client access. Do NOT edit or renumber sections 1-10.

In the new section, document each DPI 2 addition grounded in DPI2_PLAN_AND_GAP_ANALYSIS.md: (a) Amazon Cognito + Google Workspace SAML/OIDC SSO+MFA and the 4 RBAC roles (Super Admin, Infrastructure Administrator, QA Operator, Reader/Auditor) with the JWT+TOTP fallback; (b) DynamoDB as the LIVE primary store replacing SQLite (users/preferences, audit, chat history+feedback, alerts), removing the single-writer limit and enabling ECS Service Auto Scaling to >=2 tasks across 2 AZs — cross-reference existing section 5 and state DPI 2 commits to option B (DynamoDB); (c) alerts pipeline DynamoDB Streams -> Lambda Notifier -> SNS (email) + Slack/Teams webhooks, rules by severity/service with dedup; (d) CloudWatch Synthetics canaries + Route 53 health checks for QA/Main/Payment (Main/Payment labelled MOCK/WAITING_FOR_INTEGRATION until client access) + Container Insights; (e) CloudWatch Logs Insights full-stream search (severity/server/date/text/regex) + CSV/JSON/PDF export with S3 for large exports; (f) monitoring scope expands QA -> Main + Payment subject to client access.

Add a DPI 2 secrets note (extend the intent of section 6 WITHOUT editing the section 6 table in place): list SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL, and Cognito config (COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID, COGNITO_DOMAIN/issuer) — all injected from Secrets Manager, webhook URLs never sent to the browser. Do NOT touch any .env secret values.

Add a DPI 2 IAM note (extend the intent of section 7): least-privilege task-role additions — DynamoDB (read/write the DPI 2 tables), SNS (publish to the alerts topic), CloudWatch Synthetics + Logs Insights (read), S3 (put/get export objects); keep 'no write access to the customer's production app'.

Re-read the edited file to confirm sections 1-10 are unchanged, the new section 11 and the top pointer are present, the honesty framing is intact, and no DPI 1 secret values were altered. Record in findings the exact new section heading added and confirmation the two PDFs were not regenerated. Set this FEAT's status to completed.
acceptance_criteria: docs/AWS_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md contains a new, clearly-marked DPI 2 additions section covering Cognito/RBAC, DynamoDB-as-primary (+ autoscaling across AZs), SNS/Slack/Teams notifier, Synthetics/Route 53 health, Logs Insights/S3 export, new secrets, and new IAM task-role permissions.
All existing DPI 1 sections 1-10 are intact and unchanged (append-only; no rewrites, no renumbering).
Every DPI 2 item is labelled PROPOSED/TARGET and Main/Payment is labelled subject to client access; nothing implies Cognito/DynamoDB-notifier/Synthetics are already deployed.
A pointer to docs/DPI2_PLAN_AND_GAP_ANALYSIS.md and the DPI 2 diagram output (OUTPUT/Urbani_AWS_Architecture_Diagram_DPI2.svg/.png) is present.
No .env secret values were changed; OUTPUT/Urbani_DPI_Documentation.pdf and OUTPUT/Urbani_DPI2_Plan.pdf were NOT regenerated (LastWriteTime unchanged).
verification: Re-read docs/AWS_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md and confirm: new DPI 2 section present after section 10; sections 1-10 unchanged; top pointer line present; honesty framing intact.
Confirm OUTPUT/Urbani_DPI_Documentation.pdf and OUTPUT/Urbani_DPI2_Plan.pdf LastWriteTime are unchanged (not regenerated).
git diff --stat docs/AWS_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md shows only additions to that one file (no edits to packages/ or .env).
findings: Appended an append-only DPI 2 section to docs/AWS_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md plus a top pointer; DPI 1 sections 1-10 left unchanged. Exact new section heading added: '## 11. DPI 2 additions (PROPOSED — "Radar UrbiNexus")' (with subsections 11.1 Identity/Cognito+Google SSO/MFA+4 RBAC roles+JWT/TOTP fallback, 11.2 DynamoDB as LIVE primary store replacing SQLite + commits to §5 option B, 11.3 DynamoDB Streams→Lambda Notifier→SNS+Slack/Teams, 11.4 Synthetics+Route 53+Container Insights, 11.5 Logs Insights+CSV/JSON/PDF export+S3, 11.6 QA→Main+Payment scope, 11.7 DPI 2 secrets note extending §6 [SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL, COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID, COGNITO_DOMAIN], 11.8 IAM least-privilege additions extending §7, 11.9 ECS auto scaling >=2 tasks across 2 AZs). Top pointer blockquote added after the intro blockquote referencing §11, docs/DPI2_PLAN_AND_GAP_ANALYSIS.md, and OUTPUT/Urbani_AWS_Architecture_Diagram_DPI2.svg/.png.
